This template is mandatory only for outside collaborators (contributors who are
not members of the [taranis-ai/ait team](https://github.com/orgs/taranis-ai/teams/ait)).
Core members may omit these sections and do not need prompt disclosure,
contributor confirmations, or a human review-time estimate.
See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for scope and shared rules.

## LLM assistance

Used: Yes / No
If yes, paste the task prompt and material follow-up prompts, or link to the PR
comment or issue containing them. Mark redactions; omit secrets and private data.
